Maya: 👀 Heads-up — noticed a latency spike on streaming/text-gen for customer-2-prod around 12:05 UTC. p50 went from ~80ms -> ~450ms, p95 ~2.3s. Starts aligning with long prompts and increased KV cache churn.
Ravi: Any kernel/select logs or batching anomalies?
Maya: Quick summary from the profiler: kernel_selector fell back to generic_attention for a lot of requests where seq_len > 4096, and we see frequent KV cache evictions. batching stayed small (1-4) during the period.
Maya: Log snippet:
```
kernel_select: tiled_attention -> generic_attention
seq_len: 6120
kv_cache_hits: 34%
batch_policy: dynamic (1..4)
latency_ms: 2300
trace: serve/runtime/kernel_selector.cc:243
```
Lukas: Can you paste the eviction / memory snapshot? curious if it's noisy-tenant IO or simply memory pressure.
Maya: Mem and eviction excerpt:
```
KV_CACHE: capacity=12GB used=11.2GB evictions=1287/5m
heap_free: 800MB -> 120MB during spike
io_wait_ms: 0.4% -> 3.1%
```
Maya: Note: these were streaming responses with tool callbacks, some requests append tool outputs (~3k tokens) and then user message (~3k tokens) -> combined >6k tokens.
Sophie: @Maya can we repro with replay? if tool outputs are unbounded we might be hitting a kernel fallback path we didn't stress test.
Ravi: I'll spin up a perf job to replay 50 of those long traces with streaming enabled. Expect to see kernel fallback in profiler.
eng-bot: Deploy 1769.12 started 12:02 UTC; version: runtime-3.8.1. No config rollouts during spike window.
Lukas: If KV cache hits are low for these long sequences we might be evicting prefixes aggressively. Might be caused by our LRU threshold being too low for streaming sessions.
Maya: Mitigation applied: set soft-evict-threshold -> 90% (was 75%) and forced kernel hint for seq_len 4096..8192 to try tiled_attention where possible. Applied as hotfix to routing policy.
Maya: Hotfix command:
```bash
curl -X POST $ADMIN/route-hints -d '{"kernel_hint":"tiled_attention","seq_min":4096,"seq_max":8192}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```
Sophie: Good call. Did latency improve after the hotfix?
Maya: p95 dropped from 2.3s -> ~480ms within 2 minutes; KV evictions rate reduced by ~70%. Still monitoring.
Ravi: I'll attach the replay results to issue #5123 and add a unit test for long-stream kernel selection.
Lukas: Follow-up actions: 1) increase kv_cache watermark testing in CI 2) add synthetic streaming test with tool loop 3) inspect kernel_selector heuristics for multi-chunk streams.
Maya: Filed #5123 with logs + perf traces. Assigning to eng-runtime kernel team. Thanks all. :heart:
Sophie: nice response — recommend a short postmortem if we see recurrence.
Maya: Will follow up with a one-pager if it stabilizes.
